modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Krishnadasa' is derived from Hindu mythology, specifically the name of the deity Lord Krishna and the title 'das', meaning servant or devotee. In modern context, this name is most commonly associated with the renowned 16th-century Carnatic music composer and musician, Tyagaraja, who adopted the name 'Krishnadasa' as a mark of his devotion to Lord Krishna. Krishnadasa's compositions continue to be popular and are celebrated worldwide, with modern audiences accessing them through various digital platforms such as YouTube, Spotify, and Apple Music. These platforms have enabled the widespread dissemination and accessibility of Krishnadasa's music, allowing it to reach a global audience and continue to be a source of inspiration and cultural heritage.
